topic: 具身数据感知误差与认知误差区别
notes: llm dynamic expansion (medium): Map the user's Chinese framing of cognitive error to recent embodied-AI vocabulary: VLA reasoning, language-action grounding, task planning, spatial-temporal reasoning, world-model evaluation, and failure recovery.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vla-reasoning-planning
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"vision-language-action" AND (all:reasoning OR all:planning OR all:grounding)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cognitive errors in VLA systems usually appear as reasoning, planning, or grounding failures rather than under the exact phrase cognitive error.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robot-spatial-temporal-reasoning
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"robot manipulation" AND (all:"spatial reasoning" OR all:"temporal reasoning" OR all:"long-horizon")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Task-level cognition in manipulation often depends on spatial-temporal abstraction and long-horizon task structure.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-language-action-grounding
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"language-conditioned" AND all:"robot manipulation" AND (all:grounding OR all:instruction OR all:reasoning)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Instruction grounding is a common source of cognitive/task-understanding errors.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-planning-evaluation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND all:robot AND (all:planning OR all:evaluation OR all:rollout OR all:reasoning)
dynamic_suggestions.why: World models mediate between perception and cognition by turning observations into imagined futures and evaluation signals.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robot-failure-diagnosis
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:robot AND (all:"failure diagnosis" OR all:"error analysis" OR all:"failure recovery") AND (all:perception OR all:planning OR all:reasoning)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Papers that diagnose robot failures can expose whether failures come from perception, planning, or execution.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-cognitive-error-embodied
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:embodied AND (all:"cognitive error" OR all:"reasoning error" OR all:"planning error")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Direct phrasing smoke test for the user's term.
